name: Sailboat Retrospective
deliverable: Categorized operational anchors, wind, goals, and hidden rocks

steps.text: Draw the boat, island, wind, anchors, and reefs; say what each one means for this team.
Give eight silent minutes: at least two winds, two anchors, and one reef per person.
Group notes by similarity, stack duplicates to show weight, then name two anchors to cut.

failure: Anchors arrive as vague complaints and the room spends most of the hour on forces it cannot move.
intervention: Ask which specific handoff broke and what was missing from it, then park company-level items at the perimeter.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: A common agile retrospective metaphor; no single documented originator.
